narrative.overview:
The portfolio uses neutral surfaces, local Golos Text and restrained coral links to make actual applications easy to inspect. Large sentence-case headings and ample space separate the developer's voice from the application evidence. A cropped Android review screen sits beside short annotations; the native macOS settings capture keeps its application appearance.

Case-page light and dark appearances share the same composition, rules and typography. The prepared homepage and comparison route add a scoped soft-charcoal, coral and colorful-stage treatment with compact rounded boundaries; their composition is recorded in the selected surface brief. This refinement is PREVIEW, awaiting owner approval and green CI before publication. On case pages, depth belongs to the application specimens; the surrounding shell is flat, with thin dividers and direct text links. The six-slice Family Pie mark retains one coral segment, while its accompanying portfolio wordmark uses Golos Text.
keyCharacteristics: Neutral case-page surfaces in complete light and dark appearances; a scoped fixed-dark homepage preview.
Golos Text throughout the portfolio, including its compact wordmark.
Actual inline application images with adjacent explanation, source labels and independent screenshot-language controls.
Flat case-page boundaries, compact homepage frames and restrained link motion.

rules.name: The Surface Palette Rule
rules.body: Apply a color family only to the surface that owns it. Sharing fonts or a stored preference does not merge the portfolio, portal and lamp palettes.

rules.name: The Local Type Rule
rules.body: Use Golos Text for all portfolio text. Preserve Unbounded only on the existing customer wordmarks that already use it.

rules.name: The Specimen Depth Rule
rules.body: Keep the case-page shell flat; preserve application image depth there. Use the scoped homepage stage and border treatment only on its own surface.

dos: **Do** keep case-page paper, ink, quiet text, dividers and specimen stage coherent in both appearances; keep the homepage charcoal override scoped.
**Do** use local Golos Text for the portfolio, including its compact Family Pie wordmark.
**Do** keep actual inline application screens, source labels, adjacent explanations and independent screenshot-language choices readable.
**Do** retain Work and Contact in the mobile header's second row.
**Do** preserve shared language/theme preferences, visible keyboard focus and usable static links.
**Do** preserve VPN, Lumen product and Driftora purchase rules within their existing customer surfaces.
donts: **Don't** carry the old homepage portal canvas, decorative red edge lighting or catalog accordion into the replacement portfolio.
**Don't** turn the customer's portal or lamp palette into portfolio tokens.
**Don't** invent application screens, testimonials, performance numbers or customer evidence.
**Don't** present personal motivations as achieved weight loss or clinical benefit.
**Don't** describe existing Android/macOS image assets as fresh device or cross-platform acceptance.
**Don't** let the portfolio replacement remove direct product, download, legal or purchase routes.
